Class GCASolution

java.lang.Object
DSA.Graphs.GCA.GCASolution
public class GCASolution extends Object
A class representing a graph coloring solution. Stores colors as collections of vertices and provides methods to manage and write the solution.

    • writeSolution

      public Boolean writeSolution(String filePath)
      Writes the coloring solution to a file. File format: First line is the number of vertices, second line is the number of colors, followed by each color and its assigned vertices in ascending order.

      Time Complexity: O(V log V), where V is the number of vertices, due to sorting. Space Complexity: O(V) for the temporary array.

      Parameters:
      filePath - The path to the output file.
      Returns:
      True if the operation is successful, false otherwise.
